item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
This has about the subtlety and nuance of a brick to the face. It adds nothing to the story of what happened at the Branch Davidian compound, and uses layers of the Foundation universe to disguise the fact that it has nothing to say, nothing to add, and is frankly more offensive to my sensibilities by being as boring as it is than it would be if it had the temerity as writing to take any kind of stance or make any kind of point whatsoever.

It doesn't.

It stakes out controversial territory, and then totally fails to do anything interesting whatsoever with it beyond re-skinning the standard narrative with an SCP Universe slant.

item.title: Re: Geirs?
item.content:encoded: When I first published this article, I was unfamiliar with a lot of site lore, including the Unfounded Canon, or the idea of different canons. I found an article that had Charles Ogden Geirs listed as the Acting UIU Director, and assumed that I had to use his name for the UIU representative. I have since removed any reference to Charles Ogden Geirs.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
As soon as I saw you were using the Waco Siege as an -EX, I was pretty sure I was gonna hate this. The situation was a sore fuckup and I doubted one could do it justice.

And of course, you've delivered on the justice. While I was initially skeptical about the Foundation's involvement (this was, after all, a bit of an L for the ATF), you've handled the mismanagement aspect rather gracefully. I'm left with an alternate history that stays true to the lessons taught by reality, and that I can appreciate.

This is my first mainsite article, and so I'd like to give a special thanks to all the reviewers who looked over my drafts and provided helpful feedback: Zyn - Pedantique - DrChandra

For those of you interested in learning more history about the Waco Siege, this video is a good summary. I also highly encourage people to watch the WACO Series that was released on Paramount Network.
